name: Kadavu Island
note: island: the base for the whole Kadavu group, a destination rather than a spot

name: Great Astrolabe Reef
note: reef: barrier reef with 60+ dive and snorkel sites, the island's principal draw

name: Naiqoro Passage
note: dive site: marine reserve passage through the Great Astrolabe Reef, entry fee charged (Wikivoyage spells it Naigoro)

name: Soso Passage
note: dive site: passage on the reef with the largest underwater coral garden, per Wikivoyage

name: Nacomoto Passage
note: dive site: reef passage known for eagle rays and cabbage coral, per Wikivoyage

name: Manta Reef (Buliya)
note: dive and snorkel site: manta ray feeding and cleaning area at Buliya on the reef

name: Vunisea
note: town: the island's administrative centre, airstrip and ferry landing; gateway with shops and services

name: Vunisea Airport
note: airport: the island's only airport, a transport facility, not a place to go

name: Namalata Bay
note: bay: sheltered bay nearly cutting the island in two, with a clear lagoon and coral gardens; Namuana village nearby

name: Namuana Waterfall
note: waterfall: 20-minute trail from Namuana village near Vunisea, the village turtle-calling ceremony is occasional

name: Long Beach (Kadavu)
note: beach: long uninterrupted strip of white sand along the north coast, per Frommer's

name: Matana Beach
note: beach: named beach on the north coast of Kadavu, per Frommer's

name: One Mile Beach
note: beach: end point of the 10 km coastal trail from Papageno Resort, a secluded beach

name: Kavala Bay Waterfall
note: waterfall: 45-minute climb to a high waterfall with a swimming hole, reached by boat through mangroves at high tide

name: Malawai Waterfall
note: waterfall: 3.5 km walk from Papageno Resort to a small waterfall

name: Naikorokoro Cascades
note: waterfall: one-hour trail from Naikorokoro village to two sets of cascades, reached by boat from Papageno

name: Vatalutu Island
note: island: walking island with a trail network and viewpoints, reached at half or high tide with a resort

name: Kadavu Trail
note: walk: 110 km village-to-village trail across the island, unmarked and needs arrangements

name: Nabukelevu
note: mountain: 805 m inactive volcano and highest point of Kadavu, known as Mount Washington

name: Ono Island
note: island: volcanic island inside the Great Astrolabe Reef, reached by boat; manta ray snorkelling in season

name: Galoa Island
note: island: small island in Galoa Harbour off Kadavu, reached by boat

name: Dravuni
note: island: small island of the Kadavu Group with a resort, no visitor source names it as a stop

name: Waisalima Beach
note: resort: Waisalima Beach Resort and Dive Centre, accommodation, not a place to go

name: Beqa Island
note: island: lagoon island 10 km off Viti Levu, base for shark dives and firewalking villages, reached by boat from Pacific Harbour

name: Shark Reef (Beqa Lagoon)
note: dive site: bull shark and reef shark dives in Beqa Lagoon, run by operators from Pacific Harbour; the shark reef is a marine park

name: Dakuibeqa
note: village: chiefly village of the Sawau people, one of the firewalking villages on Beqa

name: Dakuni
note: village: one of the firewalking villages on Beqa

name: Raviravi Village
note: village: one of the oldest villages on Beqa, visited on a six-hour village experience with kava welcome, reached by boat across Beqa Lagoon

name: Beqa Firewalking Ceremony
note: ceremony: traditional firewalking by Beqa villages, arranged through stays and visits, not a permanent place or a fixed show

name: Yanuca
note: island: inhabited coral island east of Beqa with white beaches, now a camping site, no visitor guide named it
